description.en: The player experiences hip-region discomfort, stiffness, fatigue or movement limitation during or after tennis. This profile is used to adjust equipment recommendations and identify when movement or recovery considerations should take priority over performance goals.
description.zh: 球员在网球运动过程中或结束后出现髋部或臀部区域的不适、僵硬、疲劳或活动受限。本画像用于调整装备推荐，并判断何时应将移动能力与恢复需求置于单纯性能目标之上。

possible_contributors: Movement compensation elsewhere in the kinetic chain

equipment_strategy.primary_goal: Reduce Unnecessary Physical Demand While Preserving Stability And Easy Performance

recommended_hybrids: Natural Gut Main + Soft Polyester Cross

avoid: Very high swingweight when movement is already limited

notes: Tension reduction is intended to increase easy depth and reduce the effort required from the complete kinetic chain.
Do not lower tension excessively if launch control becomes unstable.
String material should normally be reviewed before making large tension changes.

logic.more_easy_power: Prefer slightly thinner gauge when durability permits.
logic.more_durability: Prefer 1.25 before automatically moving to very thick gauges.

equipment_objectives: Reduce unnecessary effort required to create depth
Maintain racquet maneuverability under movement pressure
Increase forgiveness when ideal positioning is unavailable
Provide predictable response during defensive contact

principle.en: Hip function is part of the kinetic chain used to transfer force through tennis strokes. Movement limitation in one segment may alter how other segments contribute.
principle.zh: 髋部是网球击球动力链的重要组成部分。某一环节的活动受限可能改变其他身体部位参与力量传递的方式。

equipment_response: Do not assume that the player should compensate with a heavier racquet.
Increase easy power before asking the player to generate more body rotation.
Increase forgiveness if movement limitations reduce ideal court positioning.

recommendation: Reduce physical demand of the racquet
Use a highly manageable racquet setup
Avoid equipment that requires repeated maximal effort
hard_constraints: Do not recommend excessive swingweight solely for stability.
Do not recommend an underpowered setup that requires constant over-swinging.
Do not allow performance goals to override significant movement limitations.

resolution: Increase power through string elasticity and racquet efficiency before increasing racquet mass.
Use predictable string response before moving to a demanding low-powered racquet.
Improve spin through string and racquet-head acceleration rather than requiring exaggerated body rotation.
Seek stability without creating excessive swingweight.

future_recovery_module.routing_rule: Physical profile identifies the affected region and severity. Specific exercise, rehabilitation or treatment recommendations must come from a separate recovery module.

message.en: Equipment changes may reduce playing demands but cannot diagnose or treat hip conditions. Persistent, significant or worsening symptoms should be evaluated by an appropriate healthcare professional.
message.zh: 装备调整可能降低打球时的身体负担，但不能诊断或治疗髋部疾病。如症状持续、明显或不断加重，应由专业医疗人员进行评估。

tradeoffs.acceptable_tradeoff: Reducing unnecessary movement and rotational demand takes priority over maximizing a single equipment performance characteristic.

must_explain: How hip sensitivity changes the equipment recommendation.
Whether maneuverability, forgiveness or easy power is being prioritized.
Why additional racquet mass is or is not appropriate.
What performance tradeoff is intentionally accepted.
Whether recovery-module assessment should be considered.
must_not_do: Do not diagnose the cause of hip pain.
Do not prescribe rehabilitation exercises from this equipment profile.
Do not assume all hip discomfort requires a lighter racquet.
Do not maximize easy power if it creates unacceptable loss of control.
